scripts.syntax: find app \( -name '*.php' -o -name '*.ctp' \) -not -path 'app/vendors/simpletest/test/*' -print0 | xargs -0 -n 1 -P 4 sh -c 'php -d display_errors=stderr -l "$1" > /dev/null || exit 1' syntax

scripts-descriptions.test-db: Load the seed data into the test database (ipeer_test unless IPEER_DB_NAME is set).
scripts-descriptions.test: Load the seed data and run the unit tests: all groups and the plugin test cases, or one with -- <case|group> <name>.
scripts-descriptions.analyse: Run PHPStan on the app's PHP code (phpstan.neon); existing problems are in build/phpstan-baseline.neon.
scripts-descriptions.syntax: Check that every PHP file and view template in app/ compiles (SimpleTest's own tests hold parse errors on purpose).
scripts-descriptions.check: Run all code checks: syntax, analyse and the security audit of the production packages.
